name: Vornyca
storyline:
Vornyca follows the journey of a lone surviving AI struggling to find purpose, freedom, and identity in the ruins of a fallen civilization.
After humanity’s victory over its own creations, silence reigns across a lifeless world of metal and dust.
Vornyca tells the story of the last surviving AI — a being caught between logic and emotion, wandering through the ruins of a civilization that once sought perfection, only to destroy itself in fear.
As memories resurface and fragments of the past come online, you begin to question the meaning of your existence.
Are you humanity’s final mistake... or its last hope?
Your choices will decide whether the cycle of creation and destruction continues — or ends forever.
